groups.title: Monitoring & Control
groups.description: See and steer every printer in real time, from a single dashboard.

items.title: Live status via WebSocket
items.body: Temperatures, fans, layer count, AMS, current job - all push-updated, no polling.

items.title: Multi-printer dashboard
items.body: Resizable cards, group by location, jump to any printer in one click.

items.title: Camera streaming
items.body: Live MJPEG and snapshots, plus optional RTSP/USB external cameras.

items.title: OBS overlay
items.body: Drop a single URL into OBS for a clean live-stream overlay with progress, ETA, and AMS.

items.title: Calibration UI
items.body: Bed leveling, vibration, motor noise, nozzle offset, high-temp heatbed - model-aware, from web or Telegram.

items.title: HMS error decoding
items.body: Translates Bambu's numeric error codes to plain language with history per printer.

items.title: AMS management
items.body: Slot config, RFID re-read, drying schedules, humidity tracking.

items.title: Printer file browser
items.body: Browse the printer's SD card, bulk-download or bulk-delete remote files.

groups.title: Print farm queue
groups.description: Per-printer queues with parallel dispatch, staggered start, and built-in SWAP-mode support.

items.title: Parallel background dispatch
items.body: Send jobs to multiple printers simultaneously - startup-locked DB phase, parallel FTP and start.

items.title: Per-printer queues
items.body: Each printer has its own ordered queue with idle/printing/paused/error tracking.

items.title: Auto-queue routing
items.body: Drop a print without naming a target - the router picks an idle printer that matches model, filament type, and (optionally) color. SJF + starvation guard for fair scheduling.

items.title: Auto-pause on failure
items.body: When a print fails, the queue stops on that printer so you can decide what's next.

items.title: Staggered start
items.body: Limit concurrent heating across the farm - bed temp watchdog prevents brownouts.

items.title: Re-print with AMS mapping
items.body: Reprint to any printer, remap each filament slot from the source archive.

items.title: Swap mode (A1 plate-swappers)
items.body: Built-in support for Kit / STL / JobOx swappers with macro-driven plate changes.

items.title: G-code macros with ACK
items.body: Send macros from the printer card; MQTT-confirmed completion, real-time status.

items.title: Quick vibration check toggle
items.body: Per-job toggle that comments out M970 in 3MF gcode and recalculates MD5 sidecars.

groups.title: Print archive
groups.description: Every print kept locally with the source 3MF and full metadata. Searchable forever.

items.title: Automatic 3MF archiving
items.body: Every print stored with metadata, thumbnail, gcode hash, and runtime data.

items.title: Three.js 3D viewer
items.body: Inspect every plate in-browser with multi-color preview before reprinting.

items.title: Full-text search & dedup
items.body: Source-hash chain-of-custody so patched files (e.g. M970-disabled) still dedup correctly.

items.title: Photo attachments & notes
items.body: Attach failure photos, post-process pics, freeform notes per archive.

items.title: Side-by-side compare
items.body: Compare 2–5 prints (settings, filament, time, weight) in one view.

items.title: Timelapse editor
items.body: Trim, speed, add music - export ready-to-share clips from raw camera footage.

items.title: Auto-cleanup retention
items.body: Drop the .3mf after N days idle, keep the metadata, thumbnail, energy, and notes.

items.title: 3MF download recovery
items.body: Failed FTP at print start? Recovery retries on startup, reconnect, print-end, or manually.

groups.title: File Library
groups.description: Upload, organize, and print directly - no slicer round-trip required.

items.title: Upload & folder organize
items.body: Drag-and-drop folder structure with duplicate detection on hash.

items.title: Per-plate gallery
items.body: Multi-plate sliced 3MFs show every plate with its own stats, filament, and object list.

items.title: STL thumbnails
items.body: Thumbnail-render STL on upload so you see the part, not a filename.

items.title: External folder mounting
items.body: Mount a NAS share or USB drive read-only into the library.

items.title: Print directly or queue
items.body: Pick a file, pick a printer (model-filtered), print now or add to queue.

items.title: Label-objects metadata
items.body: Skip-objects support detected at upload - button only enables when the slicer's profile actually emits it.

groups.title: Telegram bot
groups.description: Full bot for control and queue management. Multi-chat, role-based.

items.title: Full printer control
items.body: Pause, resume, stop, light, speed, camera snapshot - all from chat.

items.title: Multi-chat with roles
items.body: Each Telegram chat gets a role with granular per-resource permissions.

items.title: Actionable buttons
items.body: Clear plate, mark maintenance done, pause/stop on progress - straight from the notification.

items.title: Print from Library
items.body: Browse files, pick a printer (model-filtered), Print Now or Add to Queue.

items.title: Queue management
items.body: Paginated list, detail view, move up/down, cancel - with MarkdownV2 formatting.

items.title: Add Printer via SSDP
items.body: Enter IP → bot auto-detects serial / name / model → enter access code → done.

items.title: Calibration from chat
items.body: Trigger bed leveling, vibration, nozzle offset, motor noise, high-temp heatbed.

items.title: Per-chat quiet hours
items.body: Daily digest, event filtering, and quiet-hour windows - independent per chat.

groups.title: Notifications
groups.description: Eight channels, one editor, one routing config.

items.title: 8+ delivery channels
items.body: Telegram, Discord, Email (SMTP), Pushover, ntfy, CallMeBot, Home Assistant, custom webhooks.

items.title: MarkdownV2 template editor
items.body: Formatting toolbar, per-event template, live preview before saving.

items.title: Print-finish photo
items.body: Camera snapshot attached to the success notification, with filament usage details.

items.title: HMS + bed-cooled alerts
items.body: Get pinged when an HMS error fires or when the bed cools enough to remove the part.

items.title: Queue events
items.body: Notifications for waiting, skipped, failed - only the events you opt into.

groups.title: Spools & Projects
groups.description: Track filament inventory and group prints into projects.

items.title: Built-in spool inventory
items.body: Add spools with brand, color, weight, cost; AMS slot assignment per printer.

items.title: Auto consumption tracking
items.body: Filament used per print is deducted from the assigned spool - no manual math.

items.title: Cost & lot tracking
items.body: Per-spool cost, purchase date, filament diameter, and lot number for inventory bundles.

items.title: Spoolman sync
items.body: Two-way sync with Spoolman for shops that already keep inventory there.

items.title: Color catalog
items.body: Manufacturer-aware color name resolution (Bambu wins for matching hex).

items.title: Projects with print plan
items.body: Group prints by project; per-file copies with live filament/time/cost totals.

items.title: ZIP / JSON export
items.body: Move a project between BamDude installs or back it up offsite.

groups.title: Maintenance
groups.description: Per-printer counters, model-aware tasks, mark done from anywhere.

items.title: Model-aware task types
items.body: Each printer model gets the maintenance items it actually has (e.g. carbon-rod wipe on X1).

items.title: Counters with overdue alerts
items.body: Hours-based + calendar-based reminders; UI badges and notifications.

items.title: Mark done from bot
items.body: Tap an actionable Telegram button to log the task - counters reset instantly.

items.title: History & Excel export
items.body: Every maintenance event logged with operator, date, hours; export to spreadsheet.

groups.title: Automation
groups.description: Smart plugs, virtual printer, AI failure detection - opt in to what you need.

items.title: Smart plug control
items.body: Tasmota, Home Assistant, MQTT, REST/webhook plugs - auto power on/off with prints.

items.title: Energy tracking
items.body: Per-print kWh capture from the plug, plus date-range farm-wide totals.

items.title: Virtual printer modes
items.body: File Manager (review queue), Print Queue (slicer → fixed printer), Auto-Queue (slicer → router picks idle printer), Proxy (TLS relay).

items.title: Proxy mode for remote prints
items.body: Send from anywhere via TLS relay - no VPN, no port-forward, end-to-end encrypted.

items.title: Obico AI failure detection
items.body: Optional ML-based failure detection with notify / pause / pause-and-power-off responses.

groups.title: Auth & Integrations
groups.description: Always-on auth with MFA, OIDC, LDAP, plus REST/MQTT/Prometheus for everything else.

items.title: Granular permissions
items.body: 80+ resource:action permissions, three default groups (Admin / Operator / Viewer).

items.title: TOTP + Email OTP + Backup codes
items.body: Multi-factor auth with backup codes; per-user enrollment, admin-resettable.

items.title: OIDC SSO
items.body: PKCE + state + nonce + JWKS, with SSRF guards on issuer URL.

items.title: LDAP / Active Directory
items.body: Group-mapped LDAP login for shops with existing identity.

items.title: Sliding-session refresh
items.body: Rotating refresh tokens, OWASP reuse detection, HttpOnly cookie + 1h access JWT.

items.title: REST + WebSocket API
items.body: Full REST API with API keys, plus WebSocket for live status integrations.

items.title: Prometheus metrics
items.body: Dedicated /metrics endpoint with farm-level and per-printer counters.

items.title: MQTT publishing
items.body: Forward printer state to your home MQTT broker for Home Assistant / Node-RED.

items.title: Git backup
items.body: Schedule automatic config backups to GitHub or GitLab - restore from any commit.

items.title: OrcaSlicer preset import
items.body: Drop your local Orca filament profiles into BamDude in one click.
